source_read: https://menus.tenkites.com/honestburgers/honestburgers (Honest Burgers' own Ten Kites allergen and nutrition page, printed 'Updated 28 July 2026', linked from honestburgers.co.uk/allergy-information/), read live on 2026-10-16 in headless Chromium by a purpose-written reader that does not use tools/uk_extract/honest_burgers.py or its parsers: it clicked through the menu selector (Core Burgers, New Menu Trial, Honest Mighties (HB Core), Special Burgers, Local Burgers, Sides & Sauces, Drinks, Kids Meals, Gluten Free Menu, Milkshakes & Sundaes, GF Milkshakes & Toppings, and the Master Menu (Creventa) opened by its own menu id), switched to 'View nutrition information' and read the rendered figure cells (column order checked from the drawn headers: Energy kCal, Fat, of which saturates, Carbohydrate, of which sugars, Fibre, Protein, Salt), the data-calories attribute, each dish's hover texts ('Contains ...', 'May contain ...', 'Suitable for ...') and the drawn tick/M marks; plus pixel-level crops of 59 sampled rows in both the nutrition view and the allergy view, read by eye. robots.txt of menus.tenkites.com disallows only /fonts/, /views/ and /*.less$ (those paths and every third-party host were blocked in the browser); honestburgers.co.uk answered 403 to robots.txt (read as no rules, RFC 9309).
not_verifiable: (1) The halal statement in data/dietary/halal-honest-burgers.csv (honestburgers.co.uk/feedback-and-faqs/): my one plain request to that page and to /menus/ got a Cloudflare 'Attention Required' challenge (HTTP 403); I stopped and did not retry or change headers, so I could only confirm that the CSV text is byte-for-byte inside the extractor's own cached copy of the page, which is NOT an independent read of the live page. The extractor reports it read the live FAQ with its standard polite_get headers and again in Chromium (200). (2) Whether Honest Loaded Chips, Hot Sauce and the three Mighties are still sold: that rests on the chain's menu page, which I could not open (same challenge); the nutrition page itself lists all of them, the Sides and Gluten Free Sides tabs agree with each other, and the Mighties are on the HB Core tab and in the Master Menu's regular section.
notes: Result: 0 differences. All 123 rows the extractor wrote (117 published, 6 held back) exist on the live page with every one of the 8 printed figures identical: 162 item x live-row pairs (the same dish appears on 2 or 3 tabs), 1,296 figure comparisons. For every pair the 14 allergens (contains / may contain, cereal and tree-nut kinds per the generic-allergen rule of ACCURACY_AUDIT policy 2) and the vegetarian/vegan mark equal allergens.csv and the tags: 0 differences; the page's drawn tick/M icons equal its hover texts on all 276 visible rows except one unpublished local burger (GF Bank). The page's data-calories attribute equals the rendered kcal on all 276 rows. All 117 published rows: kcal within 12% of 4P+4C+9F, saturates <= fat, sugars <= carbohydrate. Random sample (seed 2026101601, every category covered, plus every judgement-call row): 59 published items read by eye from pixel crops in both views. Nutrition: all 59 identical (the 11 first crops hidden by the page's sticky header were re-shot and read: identical). Allergen matrix and vegetarian/vegan marks: 59 of 59 identical. Items in the sample: beef-burger-with-american-cheese, smashed-cheese-double, mighty-california, mighty-buffalo, chilli-con-carnage-fried-chicken, chilli-con-carnage-smashed-beef, halloumi-fries-large, cajun-tenders-small, rosemary-salted-chips, rosemary-salted-chips-kids-menu, chipotle-mayo, chipotle-mayo-kids-menu, hot-sauce, honest-pickles, vegan-chipotle-mayo, vegan-chipotle-mayo-kids-menu, homemade-lemonade, homemade-iced-tea, kids-chicken-burger, kids-beef-burger, kids-onion-rings, gf-kids-beef-burger, gf-kids-chicken-burger, gf-kids-fritter, kids-apple-juice-250ml, gf-smashed-cheese-double, gf-pesto-grilled-chicken-burger, gf-pesto-fried-chicken-burger, gf-buffalo-grilled-chicken-burger, gf-buffalo-fried-chicken-burger, gf-bbq-grilled-chicken-burger, gf-chilli-con-carnage-classic-beef, gf-chilli-con-carnage-smashed-beef, gf-chilli-con-carnage-fried-chicken, strawberry-eton-mess-milkshake, chocolate-millionaire-milkshake, madagascan-vanilla-gelato, wafers, luxury-milk-chocolate-sauce, shortbread-crumb, buffalo-sauce, bbq-mayo, bbq-mayo-kids-menu, burger-sauce-kids-menu, honest-loaded-chips, carnage-loaded-chips, buffalo-wings-small, bbq-sriracha-wings-large, bbq-sriracha-sauce, house-green-salad, vegan-house-green-salad, corn-on-the-cob, fried-corn-on-the-cob-large, onion-rings-large, american-cheese, smashed-bacon-double, tribute-burger, buffalo-fried-chicken-burger, bbq-fried-chicken-burger. Cross-checks: (a) held-back rows confirmed contradictory on the live page: Beef & Bacon Gravy 179 kcal (Sides) vs 158 (Gluten Free Sauces and Master Menu); Heinz Mayonnaise 258 (Sides, Master Menu) vs 262 (Gluten Free Sauces); Winter Coleslaw 189 (Sides, Gluten Free Sides) vs 'Seasonal Coleslaw (Autumn/Winter)' 226 on the Master Menu (held on the extractor's conservative reading: the two customer-facing tabs agree, so this hold is stricter than needed, harmless); Kids Seasonal Coleslaw is labelled Spring/Summer 2026. (b) Not published and confirmed deliberately left out: 44 Local Burgers + 37 GF local burgers + 3 Liverpool local sides (each tied to one restaurant or to no stated sites, so no 3-site proof), the New Menu Trial tab (2 sites), 7 cocktails (alcohol), French's Mustard and Lettuce (every figure printed '-'). No live row of the 276 is missing from this accounting. (c) The five kids' duplicates (Rosemary Salted Chips 262 vs 524 kcal; BBQ Mayo 75 vs 150; Burger Sauce 81 vs 163; Chipotle Mayo 95 vs 190; Vegan Chipotle Mayo 79 vs 158) are each exactly half the full-size figure in every one of the 8 columns, printed in different menus (Kids Meals tab vs Sides & Sauces / Gluten Free tabs, the Master Menu agreeing with both), so I read them as a kids' portion, not a contradiction: the extractor's publication of both, with the kids' version named after its menu, is accepted. To follow the stricter plan instead, hold the five '-kids-menu' ids and the five adult ids. (d) The 2 medium audit flags the extractor logged are confirmed on the live page: Shortbread Crumb is marked 'Suitable for Gluten Free' with Cereals with Gluten empty on both the Milkshakes and the GF Milkshakes tabs; Buffalo Sauce prints 5.1 g salt on Sides, Gluten Free and Master tabs. Judgement items for the orchestrator, none a mismatch: Kids Chicken Burger prints 66 g protein and 663 kcal (GF 61 g / 607 kcal), more than the adult chicken burgers, but it is internally consistent and identical on the Kids tab and the Master Menu's Kids Menu, so it is published as printed; Buffalo Wings Small/Large carry a stale label 'NEW RECIPE Launching 31 March' (date already past at the 28 July 2026 update; figures printed as current); Honest Loaded Chips 792 kcal is on the Sides and Gluten Free Sides tabs while only the Master Menu has 'Honest Cheesy Chips' 829 kcal (a different name, no row shares its name, so no contradiction is provable); Mighties sit under a stale 'Special Burgers: 28 July - 07 September Only' section as well as on the HB Core tab. check_chain.py honest-burgers --fail-on-high re-run: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 117 items, accuracy audit 0 high and 0 medium flags. Requests made by this reader (honest account): about 45 loads of the 3.5 MB menus.tenkites.com page in Chromium over about an hour (12 for the full read of all tabs, the rest for probes, row crops and the Master Menu, several repeated because my own selectors needed fixing), 2 curl requests to menus.tenkites.com (robots.txt, the page), 1 to honestburgers.co.uk/robots.txt (403, read as no rules) and 2 to honestburgers.co.uk pages (Cloudflare challenge 403, stopped, not retried); no 429 or block from menus.tenkites.com. Nothing under web/, no extractor change and no data/source change was needed or made.
method: independent Chromium read of the live rendered page (own selectors) + pixel crops of 59 rows read by eye in both views + cross-tab and Master Menu consistency + kcal/macro arithmetic; extractor not run and its code not used
